description: Tuples have ordered element types and a literal `length`, which makes them the main data structure of type-level algorithms.
TypeScript 4.0+: spreads inside tuple types, e.g. `[...A, ...B]`, to build and destructure tuples.
Produced by `as const` and `const` type parameters. It matches `readonly unknown[]` but not `unknown[]`.
Using a tuple's literal `length` to do type-level arithmetic.
